positioning: Present Franklin Navigator as an established Franklin-focused community network connecting residents with local businesses, professionals, organizations and resources. Keep every email concise, easy to scan, community-oriented rather than directory-oriented, and place the recipient's exact profile plus free claim/review action before optional paid membership. Do not use launch, new-service, early-adopter, first-wave, special-origin-member, or unsupported longevity language.

emails.subject: Your Franklin Navigator community profile
emails.message:
Hi {{Outreach_Greeting}},

Franklin Navigator is a local community network connecting Franklin residents with local businesses, professionals, organizations and resources.

Your community profile:
{{Profile_URL}}

You can claim it free to review and manage your business information.

Optional Community Membership — $35/year, renewing annually until canceled:
• Build a richer profile with services, hours, photos and business details
• Add website, contact, booking, quote, menu/order and social links where applicable
• Gain additional local visibility and community-participation tools
• Help Franklin residents better understand and connect with your business

Factual corrections and profile removal are always free.

Questions? Just reply and I’ll be happy to help.
